subject: The 2AM builder who hates ads
preview_text: You're part of a group that values silence over noise. This is what we built.
body_paragraphs: You're part of a group now. 6,000 people who downloaded Volume Booster Pro in the first week. Every single one came from the free version. Every single one wrote the same thing: just take the ads out and I'll pay.
That's what we did. No notifications. No interstitials. No pseudo-game layer. Just a slider and an EQ that work system-wide. The quiet utility you've been looking for.
The feature you probably haven't tried: auto-applies on headphone connect. Plug in, it boosts. Unplug, it stops. No tapping. No thinking. The app gets out of your way.
Open the app right now. Try the auto-apply. It's in settings. P.S. The premium one-time pay unlocks the full thing. No sub needed if you hate recurring bills.
